description: This Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' implements the 'LogNode' interface and serves as a filter in a logging chain. It filters log messages to output only the message text, omitting metadata like tags and priorities, and passes the message to the next node if available.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode filter that outputs only log messages by ignoring other metadata and forwarding the message to the next log node.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Overrides the LogNode's println method to output only the message text, passing it to the next node if it exists.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
